paper.title: Solution of the Transcendental Equation w e^w = x (Algorithm 443)

stack: Fortran 66/77 (netlib TOMS/CACM 443.gz shell archive: Fortran/Sp/Src/src.f, driver Fortran/Sp/Drivers/driver.f, Makefile, shipped res)

claim.text: TEST01 of the shipped driver: WEW_A(x = 1.0), the Computed column, is 0.56714326 (printed to 8 decimals in the shipped res). Registered by scout from the artifact's own reference output, not a paper table. Tolerance 1e-7 absolute, fixed before any run.

reference.note: sha256 of the extracted res file (evidence/res-shipped). The queue entry's b0ad6d70... is the sha of the decompressed shell-archive text, not of res.

attempt: G1: the authors' Makefile in the shipped layout stops at once with 'No rule to make target src.f' because src.f sits in Fortran/Sp/Src, not beside the Makefile (log kept). The build then runs the Makefile's own rules with the src.f path set to ../Src (gfortran 16.2.0, no compiler flags beyond the defaults, F77OPTS empty). No source file changed: the pre, mid and post manifests of the authors' sources are identical, so this is a build-only patch. The output of TEST01 and TEST02 is identical to the shipped res (diff exit 0), so the value matches the reference line for line. Gfortran warns about arithmetic IF (deleted in Fortran 2018); these are warnings, not errors.

original_attempt.reason: make stops with 'No rule to make target src.f, needed by src.o': the archive places src.f in ../Src while the Makefile expects it in the same directory.
